title: RBAC Role Assignment
description: RBAC role assignment: Principal + Role + Scope triplet

principal_name.description: Read-path decoration, not part of the persisted row: display name of the principal, resolved by the RBAC gear from account management or the resource-group module. Display-only — absent on write payloads, and absent on a read whenever resolution did not produce a name (deleted principal, service principal, principal outside the lookup tenant, caller without user-read, or an unavailable upstream). No length bound: the value is owned by the upstream gear.

created_by_name.description: Read-path decoration, not part of the persisted row: display name of the author, with the same resolution and same absence semantics as principal_name, plus absent for a machine author and for rows created before the author's kind was stored.

role_definition_name.description: Read-path decoration, not part of the persisted row: display name of the granted role definition, resolved from RBAC's own role_definitions table. Absent when the referenced definition was deleted inside the FK-restrict race window or the local read failed.
